invariants.rationale: A non-null restore instant timestamp is likely required for a restore operation to identify the point to restore to.
A non-null savepoint timestamp indicates a valid savepoint to restore from, which is commonly a precondition.
The HoodieEngineContext is an essential execution context and is probably not expected to be null at method entry.
Restoration likely requires a non-empty restore instant identifier; empty strings would not make sense.
A savepoint timestamp string should be non-empty, as an empty timestamp would be invalid for saving/restoring.
